text:
Deadlines are a fact of life, and handling them well is a valuable skill. The key is effective time management. Instead of panicking, break large projects into smaller, daily tasks. This makes the work feel less overwhelming and helps you track your progress.

Prioritization is also crucial. Identify which tasks are most important or urgent and tackle those first. Sometimes, you must practice scope management, which means politely saying no to new requests when your plate is already full. Finally, never underestimate the power of communication. If you see a problem coming, inform your team or manager early. They may offer help or adjust the timeline, which is always better than missing a deadline silently.
